ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 9:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Single contiguous high-intensity white region across both lobes; thin low-intensity black perimeter along the trailing edge; several small, isolated low-intensity circular focal spots (pitting) on the white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 85 degrees and a moderate depth relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, variable-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge; notably higher amplitude jaggedness on the lateral distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave curve fitted to the trailing edge boundary from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, textured pixel clusters (barnacle encrustations) concentrated on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Jagged, irregular notches on the trailing edge of the left lobe; localized barnacle colonization on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, roughly circular surface depressions (pitting) scattered across the medial and lateral regions of the ventral fluke surface.
